note: Village of New Athens campground (also listed as Kaskaskia River Camping & RV Park) on the point between the Kaskaskia River and the village boat harbor, on the river side of the levee. Seven tent sites line the river road. Site water is off November through March; hydrants for filling tanks then. --Claude
summary: RoverPass listing, campground map and booking API read; village homepage read; imagery viewed. Claimed RoverPass listing linked from the village homepage (instant book). 33 full-hookup sites (45-60 ft) at $30 + The Point premium lot $40 + 7 tent sites; 50 A; open year round, site water Apr-Oct; reservations required online. Every RV and tent site sells by the night (33 of 33 open on sampled June/January nights), so not long-stay. Riverview kept: only The Point sits at the shore with no road between.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverview kept (river about 120 m wide; no levee between the sites and the water - the levee is landward). Only 'The Point' (premium 40x90 ft lot, sold nightly at $40, at the loop tip about 38.3215,-89.8856) sits about 15 m from the river and the harbor with nothing but a riprap/brush bank between; reviewer may treat it as one riverfront site with a caveat. Sites 9-15 and 21-25 have the loop road (and on the river side the tent row 101-107) between them and the water. The south row 10-15 faces the boat harbor basin across the road.

LONG-STAY: monthly ($600) and weekly rates offered, but the booking engine sold 33 of 33 RV sites and 7 of 7 tent sites for single nights on 2027-06-08, 2027-06-12 and 2027-01-26 (16 RV on 2026-11-18); nightly share effectively 100%. Google 4.1 (76).
